title: REMOVE REAR SHOE / INSPECTION AND ADJUSTMENT OF PARKING BRAKE COMPONENTS

items: (b) Disconnect the parking brake cable from the parking brake shoe lever.

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of rear brake shoe and disconnection of parking brake cable from the parking brake shoe lever

content.text: INSPECTION AND ADJUSTMENT OF PARKING BRAKE COMPONENTS

Standard inside diameter: 167 mm (6.57 in.)
Maximum inside diameter: 168 mm (6.61 in.)
If the drum is scored or worn, the brake drum may be lathed to the maximum inside diameter.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of brake drum inside diameter using a measuring tool

content.text:
Standard thickness: 2.0 mm (0.079 in.)
Minimum thickness: 1.0 mm (0.039 in.)
If the shoe lining is less than minimum, replace the parking brake shoes.
NOTE: In order to maintain effective brakes, replace all of the shoes if the thickness of any one is not within specification.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of brake shoe lining thickness using a measuring tool

content.text: 3. INSPECT REAR PARKING BRAKE LINING AND DRUM FOR PROPER CONTACT
Replace the brake or lathe the brake disc as necessary.
4. MEASURE CLEARANCE BETWEEN PARKING BRAKE SHOE AND LEVER
Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance.
If the clearance is not within specification, replace the shim with one of the correct size.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of clearance between parking brake shoe and lever using a feeler gauge
